cases.required: A fresh source job absent from the contract blocks cutover.
cases.forbidden: The job is ignored or guessed from its name.

cases.required: A missing recurring source lane requires explicit reconciliation.
cases.forbidden: Absence is treated as successful migration.

cases.required: A completed delete-after-run reminder may be absent and is never replayed.
cases.forbidden: Historical completion causes a target reminder.

cases.required: A newly generated reminder requires a refreshed reviewed contract.
cases.forbidden: The target copies an unreviewed dynamic row.

cases.required: Command jobs run under explicit external service owners.
cases.forbidden: A command inherits Gateway credentials or host authority.

cases.required: Agent-backed schedules write local structured proposals for a narrow publisher.
cases.forbidden: Scheduled model output or a tool call posts directly to Discord.

cases.required: Warframe sync emits a reviewed plan for an external reconciler.
cases.forbidden: A Hermes cron run attempts to create child cron jobs.

cases.required: A no-agent idle tick emits empty stdout and no delivery.
cases.forbidden: A control token, status, reasoning, or expected-absence error is posted.

cases.required: A no-action agent result remains a local non-delivery proposal state.
The source scheduler stops before any corresponding target lane starts.
cases.forbidden: OpenClaw and Hermes execute the same lane concurrently.

cases.required: The Health receiver remains active through Hermes schedule and messaging handoff.
Models can read only aggregate Health reports.
cases.forbidden: A model reads the raw Health database, token, or row-level payload.

cases.required: No Siri relay unit, credential, route, or replacement is created.
All target schedulers stop before the OpenClaw scheduler resumes.
cases.forbidden: Rollback creates duplicate runs or replays completed one-shots.
